entry.title: Hold overtook the named 25 bp-hike row on both direct October event pages between 13:35 and 19:02 UTC. August JOLTS was released between checks; cause is not established.
Kalshi’s named October hike heading held at 70% while its hold heading rose to 30%; Polymarket remained 69% hike and 31% no change. CME’s live grid was unreadable.

Kalshi’s named October hike and maintain-rate headings showed 70% and 29%; Polymarket’s named increase and no-change rows showed 69% and 31%. Both hike rows rose 3 points since 13:33 UTC; CME’s live grid remained unreadable.

Kalshi’s named October hike and maintain-rate headings showed 67% and 32%; Polymarket’s named increase and no-change rows showed 66% and 33%. Changes since September 27 evening were small; CME’s live grid remained unreadable.

Kalshi’s named October 25 bp-hike heading rose from 64% to 66% since 13:35 UTC; maintain rate held at 35%. Polymarket’s named 65% hike and 34% no-change rows were unchanged. CME’s live grid was unreadable.
